description: Arm or renew the dead-man heartbeat for this wallet. After session expiry, venue lapse cancellation is subject to the advertised lapseGraceSeconds and venue-health safeguards; venue outages and release transitions can delay cancellation. Post with disarm=true to end the session without cancelling. Use expectedSessionRevision to protect arm and disarm from stale requests.

expectedSessionRevision.description: Change only this observed revision. A missing session is revision 0. Successful arm or disarm advances once; only an already explicitly disarmed successor acknowledges an identical retry. Arm retries conflict. A different session returns HEARTBEAT_SESSION_CONFLICT; never rebase an exit.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable retry key. Reuse only with byte-equivalent tool arguments.

proofNonce.description: Required single-use nonce for the wallet proof. Fetch from POST /api/auth/nonce; consumed on verification so the proof cannot be replayed.

signatureTimestamp.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) used in the signed challenge message

ttlSeconds.description: Session lifetime per beat. Post again before it elapses. Pick a TTL several times your beat interval so ordinary jitter cannot cancel your book.

walletSignature.description: Action-bound wallet proof. Sign the canonical 'problee-mcp-auth:…' challenge (binds agent, apiKey, tool, scope, chain, resource, payloadHash, nonce, timestamp).

name: kellian_orderbook_heartbeat
title: Arm or renew the maker dead-man: lapse cancels the wallet book
